messages:
alex: Quick coordination — proposing a release-gate dry run for v2.3.2 on Apr 8 at 09:30 PT. Target duration 30m. Need canary owners, rollback owners, SRE oncall, and a short runbook review. Please RSVP or react :calendar: by EOD tomorrow. Draft agenda below; open to edits.

mira: I can own canary smoke + dashboards. 09:30 PT works for me.

ben: I'm good for 09:30. Can we add a DB migration rollback sanity check? Last time we missed that.

sam: Heads up I'm oncall that morning but free at 09:30. I can take rollback owner if needed, but will be OOO from 10:00-11:00 PT.

jen: +1. I'll pull the runbook into the release board and ping product for a stakeholder rep. Link please when you post it.

release-bot: Release board updated -> https://redwood-internal/releases/v2.3.2 (canary checklist, runbook stub)

alex: Thanks — agenda suggestion (tiny, pragmatic):
```
1) Quick roll call (2m)
2) Canary owner handoff and validation plan (6m)
3) DB migration & rollback checklist confirmation (6m)
4) Toggle/feature-flag owner & quick validation (4m)
5) Contingency & rollback go/no-go criteria (6m)
6) Final signoffs and go/no-go decision (6m)
```

ben: Add: perf regression quick smoke (2m) — we can run the perf probe against the canary group.

mira: I'll bring the smoke script and dashboards. Owner: mira. Perf probe OK.

alex: Assigning owners based on replies: canary -> mira, rollback -> sam (per availability), migration checklist -> ben to confirm, perf probe -> ben. Jen will confirm product stakeholder.

jen: Pinged product; asked for a rep to join for final signoff.

sam: I can be rollback owner. Will post a condensed rollback playbook snippet in this thread tomorrow morning.

alex: Perfect. Two quick asks: 1) If you are a required attendee, please set a calendar RSVP and add your name in the release board owners table; 2) If you can't make it, post a delegate or a short note on blockers.

mira: RSVP done and owners table updated.

ben: Updated migration checklist in the board. See brief SQL rollback snippet I added.

alex: Nice. If anyone expects a long discussion item, flag it here so we can move it to a follow-up deep-dive (keep the gate meeting < 30m). Otherwise we'll run the dry run as-is. :thumbsup:

jen: Small note — A/B toggle needs a toggle-owner test matrix. I'll attach it to the board.

alex: Great. Last call: RSVP by EOD tomorrow. If no objections, I'll lock the invite at 10:00 PT and set the meeting to 30m with a 10m buffer on the calendar. Thanks all.
